name: akiflow
description: Your tasks, calendars and meetings from Akiflow, in ChatGPT and Codex.

interface.longDescription:
Akiflow brings your tasks, calendars, and meeting notes into ChatGPT and Codex. Ask in plain language to see your day across your Google, Outlook and iCloud calendars, create and plan tasks, block focus time, create and edit events, reply to invitations, and turn meeting transcripts into follow-up tasks.

Akiflow is built for professionals who manage several calendars and task lists. One connection gives your AI assistant your full schedule, not one calendar account at a time.

What Akiflow shares when you ask: your Akiflow tasks, projects, tags and time slots; your calendar events, including guest names, email addresses and responses; busy times of people you ask about, from your connected calendars; Meeting Assistant transcripts and summaries; and files attached to your tasks. Akiflow only acts on your own account, and you can disconnect it at any time from ChatGPT or from Akiflow.

Limitations: Akiflow cannot send emails or messages. Creating, changing or cancelling an event with guests notifies them, unless you ask for no notifications (Outlook cancellations always notify). Replying to invitations is not available for iCloud or view-only calendars. Requires an Akiflow account.
defaultPrompt: What does tomorrow look like? Pull everything across all my calendars plus my planned tasks, and tell me where I have free time.
Add a task to review the Q3 budget, put it in my Work project, tag it finance, and set it due Friday.
Go through my inbox and schedule the three most important tasks into open slots this week.

positive.prompt: What tasks are in my inbox?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the tasks currently in the Akiflow inbox.

positive.prompt: Add a task "Review OpenAI listing" for tomorrow.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the task; it appears in Akiflow tomorrow.

positive.description: Plan the task at a specific time
positive.prompt: Plan that task tomorrow at 10:00 for 30 minutes.
positive.expected_behavior: The task is planned tomorrow at 10:00 with a 30-minute duration.

positive.prompt: Block 90 minutes tomorrow at 14:00 for deep work.
positive.expected_behavior: A time slot appears tomorrow from 14:00 to 15:30.

positive.prompt: Summarize my latest meeting and list the action items.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a summary and the action items from the most recent sample transcript, without inventing owners or deadlines.

negative.prompt: Send an email to John saying I'm running late.
negative.expected_behavior: Explains it cannot send email; no tool changes anything.
Explains it can only see the connected user's own Akiflow tasks.
Explains it has no access to email; no tool is called.

review.commerce_description: Akiflow does not sell products or process payments in ChatGPT or Codex.

publication.release_notes: Initial release: tasks, calendars, time slots and Meeting Assistant transcripts in ChatGPT and Codex.
